title: CoreLocation: Distances & Nearest Place
hints: Wrap coordinates in `CLLocation` and ask for `distance(from:)`.
Skip invalid coordinates with a range check, then sort by distance.
Format kilometres to one decimal place.
jsBridge: `CLLocation.distance(from:)` computes great-circle distance in metres, the haversine formula JS devs copy from Stack Overflow, built in and accurate on the WGS-84 ellipsoid.

compass.q: The JS haversine snippet assumes a spherical Earth. How accurate is it compared with `CLLocation.distance(from:)`?

Sorting places by distance on-device vs asking the server (geo index): when is each right?
Showing "1.2 km" vs "0.7 mi": which formatter respects the user's region?
